title: UK Fintech Funding Analysis: London Dominates Seed Capital
metaDescription: Explore UK fintech funding data showing £622.3m raised across 100 startups. Discover regional concentration, team sizes, and industry breakdowns.
intro: An analysis of 100 UK fintech companies reveals a total funding of £622.3m, with a mean of £6.2m and a median of £4.1m. The top 10 firms command 33% of all capital raised, while every single company in the dataset is currently at the Seed stage.

sections.heading: Regional Disparities and London Concentration
sections.body: London dominates the landscape with 78 firms capturing £504.6m, representing 81% of total funding. Meanwhile, the South West punches above its weight with an average of £10.0m across 5 companies, outstripping the national mean. At the other end of the scale, Wales, the West of Scotland, the North East, and the East Midlands account for just 1 company each.

sections.heading: Outlier Funding and Team Size Dynamics
sections.body: Funding ranges from a maximum of £30.3m secured by Nevis down to a minimum of £2.0m raised by Ledger Rocket. Firms with 25-49 employees achieve the highest group average at £9.7m across 10 businesses, compared to £5.9m for the 49 companies sized at 10-24 employees. The smallest teams with under 5 staff account for 11 startups averaging £4.7m.

sections.heading: Sector Performance and Capital Distribution
sections.body: Data provision and analysis leads by company count with 35 firms raising £227.5m in total. Risk and compliance registers the highest sector average at £7.9m across its 15 businesses. Conversely, investment banking and corporate finance features 20 firms but records a lower average of £4.1m.
